scenarios.name: CRTok-01 the revision completion-token ceiling constant is 8192

steps.text: the critic module constant REVISION_MAX_COMPLETION_TOKENS equals 8192

scenarios.name: CRTok-02 run_revision forwards the raised ceiling to the LLM client

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid RevisionDelta
the LLM complete call is made with max_completion_tokens 8192

scenarios.name: CRTok-03 a revision response larger than the old ceiling is accepted

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta reporting completion_tokens <completion_tokens>
the revision succeeds without a truncation warning
a revised ControlStructure model is produced

scenarios.name: CRTok-04 a truncated revision still degrades gracefully

steps.text: an LLM whose revision call raises LengthFinishReasonError
the returned ControlStructure is the pre-revision control structure
the warnings list includes a warning that mentions LengthFinishReasonError

an LLM that returns a valid CriticFindings JSON
the LLM complete call is made without a max_completion_tokens cap
